description: One place the agent may send a Slack message. A Slack bot can only post into a channel it has been invited to, so every destination here is a channel that already has the bot in it.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: What the accountant will call this when asking the agent to send something - for example 'Finance Team'.

fields.label: Channel ID
fields.description: The channel id Slack shows at the bottom of the channel's details pane, starting with C - for example C0123ABCD45. It is not the #name of the channel.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Where a Slack message goes when the accountant does not name a destination.

name: Agent Slack Destination
